title: The Backwater Pavilion
description: A climate-responsive lakefront residence designed along Alappuzha's coastal channels. It features floating timber decks, pitched clay roof rafters, and sliding louvers that capture lake breezes while shielding extreme monsoon rainfall.
metaTitle: The Backwater Pavilion | Architectural Design Alappuzha
metaDescription: Explore a modern waterfront villa built in traditional Nalukettu physics, blending teak frames and clay roofs.

title: Kuttanad Heritage Modern
description: An adaptive interior restoration of a heritage Kuttanad courtyard homestead. The layout incorporates elevated stone plinths to adapt to backwater tide rises, central open light wells for air circulation, and solid teak joints.
metaTitle: Kuttanad Heritage Interior | Kerala Interior Design
metaDescription: See how we restored a heritage courtyard interior to be climate-resilient with bespoke teak millwork and lime plaster.

title: Vazhicherry Creative Studio
description: A master-planned, light-flooded workspace pavilion designed for a creative studio in Vazhicherry. Built with operable wooden screen grids to provide cross-ventilation overlooking a lily pond.
metaTitle: Vazhicherry Studio Planning | Site Zoning & Layout
metaDescription: An architectural planning and site layout case study for a light-flooded creative studio in Vazhicherry.

title: Alleppey Canal House
description: A biophilic landscape and architectural renovation of an urban canal-side residence in Alappuzha. Employs brick latticework screens, native flora courtyards, and rainwater retention channels.
metaTitle: Alleppey Canal House | Biophilic Landscape Architecture
metaDescription: Discover how canal-side landscape architecture and native planting screens transformed an urban residence in Alappuzha.

title: Vembanad Lake Retreat
description: A private waterfront retreat oriented strictly toward the monsoon winds of Lake Vembanad. Integrates deep shaded verandahs and traditional timber joinery with contemporary low-energy living.
metaDescription: A serene tropical waterfront sanctuary designed in timber and laterite stone overlooking the backwaters.

title: Marari Courtyard Homestead
description: A peaceful coastal residence designed around a sunken open-air central courtyard. Breathable lime-washed walls and custom wood cabinetry create a serene coastal aesthetic.
metaTitle: Marari Courtyard Homestead | Coastal Kerala Interior
metaDescription: Explore a light-filled coastal home centered around a tranquil interior rainwater light well.

title: Punnamada Water Pavilion
description: An iconic modern home overlooking the Punnamada backwaters. Floating cantilevered roofs shade the floor-to-ceiling glass openings, shielding direct tropical solar heat while capturing river reflections.
metaDescription: A modern villa capturing panoramic backwater reflections with deep overhangs and passive cooling.

title: Pathiramanal Tropical Gardens
description: Landscape master plan incorporating rainwater retention swales, indigenous backwater flora, and sunken sitting decks that harmoniously merge garden habitats with coastal architecture.
metaTitle: Pathiramanal Tropical Gardens | Ecological Landscape Planning
metaDescription: A sustainable Kerala garden and courtyard design combining rainwater swales with native coastal flora.

title: Alappuzha Heritage Guildhall
description: Urban master plan and adaptive reuse strategy for a historic trading warehouse in the canal quarter. Transformed into an artisan workspace with natural sky-lit corridors.
metaTitle: Alappuzha Heritage Guildhall | Urban Adaptive Reuse
metaDescription: Master planning and spatial restoration of a heritage canal-side warehouse into a modern artisan collective.
